### Ran Playwright code
await (async (page) => {
  // We should already be on the joke page from previous run
  // But let's make sure
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Tell me a Joke' }).click();
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  
  // Click randomize on the first model
  const randomizeBtn = await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Random other model' }).first();
  await randomizeBtn.click();
  
  // Wait a bit longer
  await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
})(page);
